subject: Implement XXH_NO_INLINE_HINTS to disable forced inlining.
change_summary: Adds an option to disable forced inlining in XXH3 functions.

units.name: Adds an option to disable forced inlining in XXH3 functions.
units.evidence: Seven default-build public targets prove bidirectionally; with the new no-inline option, five targets prove but two do not get a solver verdict. The -Os configurations contain non-returning targets.

notes: The verdict covers only the indicated targets and configurations; inconclusive cases are not counted as equivalence.
